mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, company_name, title, job_category, employment_type, location, salary_min, salary_max, experience_level, education_level, description, requirements, preferred_qualifications, accessibility_info, wheelchair_accessible, accessible_restroom, disabled_parking, remote_available, flexible_work_available, assistive_device_support, deadline, status, created_at, updated_at FROM interest_job WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interest_job (member_id, company_name, title, job_category, employment_type, location, salary_min, salary_max, experience_level, education_level, description, requirements, preferred_qualifications, accessibility_info, wheelchair_accessible, accessible_restroom, disabled_parking, remote_available, flexible_work_available, assistive_device_support, deadline, status) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{companyName}, #{title}, #{jobCategory}, #{employmentType}, #{location}, #{salaryMin}, #{salaryMax}, #{experienceLevel}, #{educationLevel}, #{description}, #{requirements}, #{preferredQualifications}, #{accessibilityInfo}, #{wheelchairAccessible}, #{accessibleRestroom}, #{disabledParking}, #{remoteAvailable}, #{flexibleWorkAvailable}, #{assistiveDeviceSupport}, #{deadline}, #{status})
